brief.title: Plan an audience acceptance test
brief.plain_summary: Write the plan for one video: audience segments with viewer counts, tasks from the task bank, a muted viewer, the device, a consent line saying what is and is not recorded, and pass criteria per task and segment, dated before any session.

video.description: Pin of the video's encoded file media noun.

video_brief.description: Pin of the video brief: its audience and point.

required: Take the segments from the brief's audience; name each.
Choose tasks that test the brief's point; keep open tasks before closed ones.
Fix and date the pass criteria before any session is booked.
Propose the user acceptance testing pack's agree-criteria for this exact plan version; sessions start only from an agreed version.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
